name: Rumor Central
readNote: Read 1, Fri Nov 6, 2026 about 8:30am ET, from the public AI pages of kalshi.com and polymarket.com. Neither page printed a time for its prices. Baselines come from Baseline 0 (ai-desk/predictions/baseline-2026-11-06.md). Read only. No trades.
policy: No individual posters are named. Rumors are claims, not people.
Every price names its venue and when it was read.
Local items use public counts, never invented odds.
Suggestions are moderated and shown without names.

rumors.claim: GPT Astra 6.1+ ships this week (Nov 2 to 8)

related.note: Kalshi's wording is Astra 6.1, Polymarket's is 6.1+. Check both rule sheets before reading this gap as disagreement.

rumors.ifTrue: Re-run any workflow card that names a GPT model and note what changed in output.
rumors.lesson: Window contracts (Nov 2 to 8) and cumulative ones (by Nov 9) answer different questions. Add the windows up before comparing.

rumors.claim: The second El Segundo City Council seat is still in play

local.signal: 151 votes between second and third place; first and second are 5 votes apart
local.fogRule: Fog = 100 minus 20 times the margin as a percent of the two candidates' votes. A count, not a price.
local.source: elsegundo.xyz/elections/2026, semi-official LA County Registrar count, 5:45pm PT Nov 5. Not a final result.

reach.note: The elections page, shared in one local group chat of about 25. About 6 clicks, an estimate.

rumors.ifTrue: The count keeps moving until certification. Recheck after each Registrar update.
rumors.lesson: A local race has no market. The count is the signal, and the margin is the fog.

local.fogRule: Same rule as the council seat. A 66-point margin leaves no fog.
local.source: elsegundo.xyz/elections/2026, semi-official count, 5:45pm PT Nov 5. Not a final result.

rumors.ifTrue: Moves to the ledger as confirmed once the county certifies.
rumors.lesson: Settled in the count, open on paper until certification.
